requirements.quote:
A recovered packet number that is lower than any
   packet number from the current key phase uses the previous packet
   protection keys
requirements.condition: When a recovered packet number is lower than every packet number observed in the current key phase and old packets are being supported.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the previous packet-protection keys to remove protection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Selecting the current or next packet-protection keys for this packet-number relation.
requirements.why_checkable: Packets with controlled recovered numbers can verify which receive-key set is selected.

requirements.quote:
a recovered packet number that is higher than any
   packet number from the current key phase requires the use of the next
   packet protection keys.
requirements.condition: When a recovered packet number is higher than every packet number observed in the current key phase.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the next packet-protection keys to remove protection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Selecting the previous or current packet-protection keys for this packet-number relation.
requirements.why_checkable: Packets with controlled recovered numbers can verify which receive-key set is selected.

requirements.quote:
Some care is necessary to ensure that any process for selecting
   between previous, current, and next packet protection keys does not
   expose a timing side channel that might reveal which keys were used
   to remove packet protection.
requirements.condition: When selecting among previous, current, and next receive packet-protection keys.
requirements.required_behavior: Perform selection and unprotection without an observable timing signal that reveals the key set used.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Exposing a timing side channel that distinguishes which receive keys removed packet protection.
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled packets for each key set can be measured statistically for distinguishable processing-time distributions.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MAY allow a period of approximately the Probe Timeout
   (PTO; see [QUIC-RECOVERY]) after promoting the next set of receive
   keys to be current before it creates the subsequent set of packet
   protection keys.
requirements.condition: After promoting the next receive-key set to current and before creating the subsequent set.
requirements.required_behavior: If generation is deferred, limit the deferral to a period approximately equal to the PTO.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Deferring generation for substantially longer than the intended PTO-scale interval.
requirements.why_checkable: The text does not define a tolerance for "approximately", so no objective pass/fail timing boundary can be constructed from this evidence alone.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints SHOULD wait three times
   the PTO before initiating a key update after receiving an
   acknowledgment that confirms that the previous key update was
   received.
requirements.condition: After receiving an acknowledgment confirming that the peer received the previous key update.
requirements.required_behavior: Wait three times the PTO before initiating another key update.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initiating the next key update before the three-PTO waiting period expires.
requirements.why_checkable: A simulated clock can compare the confirming acknowledgment time, PTO value, and next key-update event.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint SHOULD retain old read keys for no more than three times
   the PTO after having received a packet protected using the new keys.
   After this period, old read keys and their corresponding secrets
   SHOULD be discarded.
requirements.condition: Once three times the PTO has elapsed after receiving a packet protected with the new keys.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Retaining the old read keys beyond that deadline.
requirements.why_checkable: A simulated clock and key-store inspection can verify deletion by the three-PTO deadline.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint SHOULD retain old read keys for no more than three times
   the PTO after having received a packet protected using the new keys.
   After this period, old read keys and their corresponding secrets
   SHOULD be discarded.
requirements.condition: Once three times the PTO has elapsed after receiving a packet protected with the new keys.
requirements.required_behavior: Discard the secrets corresponding to the old read keys.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Retaining the corresponding old secrets beyond that deadline.
requirements.why_checkable: A simulated clock and secret-store inspection can verify deletion by the three-PTO deadline.
